hints.title: Turn Invariant
hints.text: To reach a total of one hundred and fifteen, every turn strictly requires picking exactly one coin of value seventy-five and four coins of value ten.

hints.title: Capacity Bottleneck
hints.text: Calculate the total number of complete turns possible as the minimum between available seventy-five coins and quarters of available ten coins.

hints.title: Parity Decider
hints.text: If the count of playable turns is odd, Alice takes the last valid turn and wins. Otherwise Bob wins.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct integer arithmetic in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Turn-by-turn simulation is redundant when round capacity is computable directly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes the fixed combination required per round and computes turns in O(1).
